India's T20I Debutant Vaibhav Suryavanshi Still Waiting for Chance

Vaibhav Suryavanshi, the Indian cricketer, is still waiting for his chance to debut in a T20 International match. The team has made two changes to its playing XI against Ireland, with Prinz Yadav and Shardul Thakur making their debuts. Suryavanshi's inclusion in the team remains uncertain.
